lines.zh: 我在浑水里慢慢游，尾巴一摆一摆。
lines.en: I swim slowly through the muddy water, tail swinging.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底走，嘴巴朝下。
lines.en: I keep to the riverbed with my mouth turned down.

lines.zh: 我成群地往前，旁边都是同伴。
lines.en: I move in a shoal, herdmates all around me.
I go with the current and spend little effort.

lines.zh: 我摆一下尾，能滑出去很远。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail carries me far.

lines.zh: 我游过浅滩，背露出来一点。
lines.en: I cross the shallows with my back showing.

lines.zh: 我不急，水里没什么好急的。
lines.en: I am unhurried; there is nothing to hurry for in the water.

lines.zh: 我的鳍慢慢扇着，保持方向。
lines.en: My fins beat slowly to hold my course.
I follow the bank, looking for fruit.
One tail beat takes me into the deep.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I hover, gills opening and closing.
My mouth works slightly.
I am waiting for fruit to fall.

lines.zh: 我只摆一下尾巴，稳住身体。
lines.en: A single tail beat holds me steady.

lines.zh: 我看不清远处，水太浑了。
lines.en: I cannot see far; the water is too murky.
My scales carry a dull sheen.
I ease in among the weeds.
I have no need to come up.
The scent of herdmates is here.
My gill cover closes slowly.
I keep to the bottom, very quiet.
I feel the water move.
I turn and let the current pass over my back.

lines.zh: 我游过来，看着岸上的你。
lines.en: I swim over and look at you on the bank.
You have put your hand in the water.

lines.zh: 我在看那是食物还是别的。
lines.en: I am deciding whether that is food or something else.
My mouth points your way.
I am in the water; you are on the bank.
You hold still, and I have not left.

lines.zh: 水面把我的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: The surface stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我从你的倒影下面游过去。
lines.en: I swim beneath your reflection.

lines.zh: 你这样看着，我不太习惯。
lines.en: I am not used to being watched like this.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我搅起来了。
lines.en: I have stirred up the silt.
I want to know what you are waiting for.

lines.zh: 我贴着岸边游，离你很近。
lines.en: I swim along the bank, very close.
I open my mouth once and close it.
One tail beat shoots me away.
A flick of my fin and my pale belly shows.
My side fin is torn open.
I shake my head and churn the water.
I swim crooked for a while.
I sink back to the bottom.

lines.zh: 水里还没谁能把我逼到这份上。
lines.en: Nobody in this water has pushed me this far before.
It stings, but I can still swim.
Fruit? I like that.

lines.zh: 那不是掉下来的，是你给的。
lines.en: That did not fall; you gave it.

lines.zh: 我摆尾冲过去，水都浑了。
lines.en: I beat my tail over and the water clouds.
I can swallow it in one go.
I bump your hand.

lines.zh: 同伴也闻到了，我得快些。
lines.en: Herdmates smell it too; I must hurry.
That is not enough; is there more?

lines.zh: 水面上那点碎食，我不抢白不抢。
lines.en: Free scraps on the surface? I'm not passing that up.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我一摆尾滑开。
lines.en: You touch me and one tail beat slides me clear.
I am slippery to the touch.
My scales brush your leg.
I have swum back.

lines.zh: 我不生气，水里的碰撞常有的。
lines.en: I am not angry; bumps happen in water.

lines.zh: 撞一下怎么了，河水又不是你家的。
lines.en: So I bumped you. The river isn't yours.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我要去水草那边。
lines.en: Out of my way, I'm heading for the weeds.

lines.zh: 鳞片滑得很，撞上了别怪我。
lines.en: My scales are slick, so don't blame me for the bump.

lines.zh: 我们到季节了，就是这样。
lines.en: The season has come; that is all it is.
I swim back and forth beside her.

lines.zh: 我们在水草里挨得很近。
lines.en: We press close among the weeds.

lines.zh: 水底被我们搅起一层泥。
lines.en: We stir a layer of silt off the bottom.
The herdmates are all doing the same.
I turn and press against her side.
We swim paired for a while.
Rings spread on the surface.
Afterwards I return to the shoal.
The water is never quiet.
I swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的一点点吐出来，看看。
lines.en: I spit a little of it out to look.
It has gone soft in the water.
I nudge it and it sinks.
I took it for fruit.
I hold it in my mouth and swim off.
I nudge it with my snout.
A herdmate wants it; I swim away.
I cannot get this down.
I turn sharply.
There is a sound in the water; I listen.
I swim that way, not fast.
I come out of the weeds.
I see something on the surface.
This is not a usual sound.
One tail beat and I am faster.
I follow along the bank.

lines.zh: 水流把那东西送到我嘴边。
lines.en: The current brings it to my mouth.
I watch half-submerged.

lines.zh: 我犹豫了一下，又过去了。
lines.en: I hesitate, then go anyway.
Herdmates come along with me.
There is a small splash.
I lower my head to the surface.
I follow the disturbance on the surface.
You walk; I follow in the water.
I swim along the bank.

lines.zh: 我的背露出来又沉下去。
lines.en: My back shows, then sinks.
My tail beats very quietly.
I stay just below your flank.
The other fish here have made way.
I need not be quick; I only need follow.
The water carries the smell to me.
I am patient; I wait for it to stop.
Herdmates spread into a ring.

lines.zh: 我从下面过去，水流先到。
lines.en: I pass underneath, and the current arrives first.
I want a clear look before moving.

lines.zh: 我游到浅处，鳍都快露出水面。
lines.en: I move into the shallows, fins nearly breaking the surface.
The circle keeps shrinking.
I follow the current with no sound.
It has suddenly gone still.
I open my mouth and bite.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴拍过去，水花四溅。
lines.en: My tail slaps across, spraying water.
I strike your leg underwater.

lines.zh: 我的牙磨着你的脚踝不放。
lines.en: My teeth grind your ankle, holding.
I strike and swim off.
I have churned the water thick.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，从侧面撞过去。
lines.en: I roll and hit from the side.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还有它的一点味道。
lines.en: A trace of the taste stays in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我照着水下的影子咬过去。
lines.en: I bite at the shadow under the water.

lines.zh: 我用厚实的头骨顶了一下。
lines.en: I butt with my heavy skull.

lines.zh: 尾巴横着扫，把水推出浪。
lines.en: My tail sweeps across and the water breaks.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝，往深处拖。
lines.en: I clamp your ankle and pull toward the deep.

lines.zh: 这一下没咬准，只是擦过去。
lines.en: That missed and only grazed.

lines.zh: 我又退回水里，绕了半圈。
lines.en: I slip back into the water and circle half around.
A shadow appears under the surface.
I rise from the deep.
A ring of ripples crosses the river.
I beat my tail and turn for the bank.

lines.zh: 这里的水不错，浑得正好。
lines.en: The water here is good, nicely murky.
I fall in among a shoal.

lines.zh: 这片水面的果子都熟了吧。
lines.en: The fruit over this water must be ripe.
I swim slowly and learn the water.

lines.zh: 我沿着河底过来，没惊动谁。
lines.en: I come along the bottom without disturbing anything.

lines.zh: 我的鳃在冷水里张得很大。
lines.en: My gills open wide in the cold water.
I have not been to this stretch of bank.
A patch of the river suddenly clouds.

lines.zh: 我跟着涨起来的河水进来。
lines.en: I come in with the risen water.

lines.zh: 岸边湿了一片，是我蹭的。
lines.en: A patch of the bank is wet where I brushed it.

lines.zh: 我从桥下的阴影游出来。
lines.en: I swim out of the shade under the bridge.

lines.zh: 水里的果子落下来，我来了。
lines.en: Fruit fell into the water, so I came.

lines.zh: 我跟在一群鱼后面过来。
lines.en: I come trailing a shoal of fish.
The water scalds and I sink lower.
I land on the bank, tail flailing.

lines.zh: 水太多也会呛人，我张大嘴。
lines.en: Even water can drown you; I gape wide.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，我被抛出水面。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and throws me out of it.
Something lodged under my ribs.

lines.zh: 一股力顺着水过来，我僵住了。
lines.en: Some force comes through the water and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 我饿得没了力气，游不快。
lines.en: Hunger drains me; I cannot swim fast.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 没有水，也没有地，我只剩乱摆。
lines.en: No water, no ground; only thrashing.
